name: Disallow
oracle_text: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability. (Mana abilities can't be targeted.)
blocked_sentences: Counter target spell, activated ability, or triggered ability.

needs.what: a single target kind whose pool spans every stack object -- spells and activated/triggered abilities on the stack together (e.g. kind "spell_or_ability", optionally narrowed by controller) -- so one instance of the word "target" can pick either a spell or a non-mana ability, and `counter` on that binding counters whichever it is
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Target kinds offer 'spell' and 'ability_on_stack' separately but no union of the two ('spell_or_permanent' and 'spell_permanent_or_graveyard_card' are the only multi-pool kinds, and neither covers abilities). Two target specs would make the card target twice and need both legal; a choose_mode between 'counter target spell' and 'counter target ability' is a modal card, a different choice made at a different time, not one target
